title: ReCDA: Concept Drift Adaptation with Representation Enhancement for Network Intrusion Detection

problem.claim: Learning-based network intrusion detection is challenged by concept drift caused by evolving attack technology, dynamic attack behaviors, and changing traffic distributions.

gap.claim: Existing approaches require substantial labeled drifting samples, creating labor-intensive manual labeling and label-noise risks.

contributions.claim: ReCDA combines self-supervised representation enhancement with weakly-supervised classifier tuning for concept drift adaptation.
The representation enhancement stage uses drift-aware perturbation and representation alignment to learn robust drift-aware and drift-invariant representations.
The classifier tuning stage uses instructive sampling and a robust representation constraint to learn discriminative benign and malicious activity knowledge.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The study evaluates the method across multiple benchmark datasets and different levels of concept drift.
The authors report that ReCDA demonstrates superior adaptability and robustness.

narrative_sequence.summary: Network intrusion detection is affected by concept drift and evolving traffic distributions.
Existing methods rely on substantial labeled drifting samples, with labeling cost and label-noise risks.
ReCDA addresses the problem through self-supervised representation enhancement and weakly-supervised classifier tuning.
The method is evaluated on benchmark datasets across varying concept-drift degrees, with reported adaptability and robustness.

source_observation.claim: Concept drift makes historical traffic distributions diverge from recently arrived traffic, while labeled drifting samples are costly and potentially noisy.

interpretation.claim: A practical adaptation strategy may reduce dependence on extensive manually labeled drifted data by combining representation learning with weak supervision.

application.claim: For evolving network intrusion detection streams, consider drift-aware representation learning before classifier tuning.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish effectiveness outside the reported benchmark datasets or drift conditions.

unknowns: How concept drift is generated or measured
Amount and source of labeled data used
Ablation results for the method components
